newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY WEAKER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against hard currencies at the close of Tuesday's interbank session, dealers said.
"The local currency was generally trading in narrow ranges today. It was marginally weaker at the end of the day though we saw a few sellers towards the close of business," commented one dealer.
He said the local currency finished at 11.1475/1575 against the U.S. dollar, down from 11.1350/1450 on Monday and fell against sterling to 17.8700/8900 from 17.8000/8300.
It was quoted easier against the mark at 6.5600/5700 compared to 6.5200/5400 and against the rand at 2.5200/5300 from 2.5000/5200.
